end.summary:
Recognised some equal-share fractions using shapes and groups.
Compared 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 correctly in four attempts.
Named 1/4, 3/4, 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 of quantities in later examples.
Part-to-part versus part-of-the-whole mix-up appeared and was not confirmed corrected at the final check.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised fractions as equal shares with shapes, groups of objects, and division. Nisha used the equal-size rule and correctly compared unit fractions and found fractions of quantities in several examples. They sometimes described a fraction using the parts left instead of the total whole; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, draw shapes split into 2, 3, and 4 equal parts and ask, “How many shaded parts out of how many total parts?”
